mentions.name: SPLADE-easy
mentions.description: A simple, portable retrieval index for SPLADE sparse vectors that encodes and serializes documents into flatbuffers and appends them into shards. Retrieval runs as a parallel flat scan with optional reranking, targeting high quality hybrid retrieval for local search, RAG, or deep research scenarios.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a simple retrieval index for SPLADE sparse vectors, finding existing options like Faiss or Anserini bigger and more complex than needed.
mentions.audience: Local search, RAG, or deep research scenarios
mentions.source_excerpt:
SPLADE-easy: https://github.com/dleemiller/splade-easy

I wanted a simple retrieval index to use splade sparse vectors. This just encodes and serializes documents into flatbuffers and appends them into shards. Retrieval is just parallel flat scan, optionally with reranking.
